title: News
summary: Dated news rows with NEW! badges and category tabs under an oversized watermark: the front page of an official site.

title: Sign in
summary: Email and password with native validation, remember-me, a forgot link, and a divider to OAuth: the form that every app starts with.

title: Dashboard
summary: Sidebar and toolbar shell with a stats row, a trend chart, and recent orders. On a phone, the sidebar becomes a strip that scrolls sideways.

title: On Air
summary: Broadcast schedule as a station table, with streaming services below. On a phone, it stacks into label and value rows.

title: Character
summary: A grid of character cards. Each card opens a hash-routed modal with the profile and cast. Deep links survive reload.

title: Settings
summary: Profile, notifications, and a danger zone as stacked panels in one form. Enter saves and Discard restores. A sticky save bar stays in view.

title: Data page
summary: Breadcrumb, a title row with a primary action, a status filter, and a sortable, searchable, selectable data table. A person can undo the bulk Remove.

title: Staff & Cast
summary: Credits as two definition lists side by side, with roles in ink labels and names beside them. On a phone, they stack.

title: Release
summary: Blu-ray and CD release cards with cover, price, date, and a purchase button, soonest first. The grid reflows on phones.

title: Page states
summary: The three non-happy paths that every list needs: loading skeleton, empty with a call to action, and error with retry. One `state` switch controls them.

title: Pricing
summary: Three tiers with a monthly and yearly switch, a highlighted recommended plan, and a feature checklist.

title: Story
summary: Episode list: number, title, air date, and a synopsis that expands, under a short premise.

title: Inbox
summary: Two-pane mail: a list with unread indicators, and a reading pane. A person can undo Archive and Delete. On a phone, it collapses to one pane with a back button.

title: Full site
summary: All six official-site sections inside BlessStage, with sidebar nav and scroll-spy, a key-visual background, and a drawer on phones. It opens full-page.

title: Chat
summary: A conversation thread that sticks to the bottom, with a composer that sends on Enter (never mid-IME conversion) and a typing indicator.

title: Onboarding
summary: A three-step first-run wizard (workspace name, invite teammates, pick a palette) with a progress header and a finish screen.
